James had previously sued Donald Trump and his company for fraud while he was running for office.
New York Attorney General Letitia James was charged Thursday by the US Justice Department as part of a mortgage fraud investigation pushed by President Donald Trump
James had drawn the ire of Trump when she sued him and his company for fraud while he was running for office.
James' office did not immediately respond to the charges against her, although her lawyers have denied them, saying they represent an act of political revenge from President Trump.
This is a developing story, more details to come...
title: New York Attorney General Letitia James indicted – DW – 10/09/2025
